verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has a documented case-management queue. Teams can prioritise and review risk alerts, filter cases by stage, assignee and risk, and escalate complex cases to human review. Reviewers record case decisions (no risk detected / accepted / offboard), with a case audit trail and API-based remediation. However, the review queue covers AML screening alerts, not identity-document verifications, so there is no evidence of document images or extracted fields being shown to reviewers. Missing for 10: document images and extracted ID fields in the review view, explicit routing of borderline verification results (rather than screening hits) to the queue, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
